sjv.name: San Joaquin Valley, California
sjv.publish_note: The site's San Joaquin layer is the team's research export (GPS-tied, two tracks, infrastructure sampling). This config reproduces only the untied ascending-track map, so it is written to pipeline/out/ and never replaces site/data/sjv.js.

reference.name: Volcanic hills west of the graben

delhi.name: Delhi NCR

reference.name: Southern Aravalli ridge (Bandhwari, Gurugram-Faridabad hills)
reference.reason: Delhi Supergroup quartzite hills, 79 m above the plain; coherent in 19 of 19 pairs. The first choice, the Central Ridge (77.17, 28.62), lies in a strip that is incoherent or outside the frame in about half the pairs (reference coherent in 53 % of pairs, gate refused).

delhi.location_check: Does not match: the literature maximum is Kapashera near IGI airport (>11 cm/yr 2014-2020, Garg et al. 2022); our map reads -1.4 +- 1.1 cm there over 276 days. Our deepest area is ~20 km further W, beyond Gurugram (76.88E 28.49N), not described in that paper. Reference moved to the southern Aravalli ridge after the Central Ridge failed the reference check.
delhi.publish_note: Not published (2026-11-14): status "unconfirmed", see unconfirmed_reason and location_check. The files that were published are kept in pipeline/out_v2/delhi/unpublished/.
delhi.unconfirmed_reason: Passed our automatic quality checks, but we don't see the sinking area described in published studies; our strongest signal is about 20 km west of the area they describe (Kapashera, near the airport), so we don't report a number.

hengshui.name: Hengshui (North China Plain)

reference.name: Plain W of Hengshui (no bedrock in the box)
reference.reason: North China Plain: no bedrock within reach. Chosen by rule: coherent in 9 of 9 pairs, change within 0.5 cm of the scene's non-moving cells, epoch noise below the scene median, >= 5 km from any cell sinking > 2 cm and >= 15 km from the literature funnel centre (Hengshui city). The plain itself may sink slowly, so values are relative to it.

stable_areas.name: Plain W of Hengshui (no bedrock in the box)

hengshui.location_check: Does not match: Hengshui city, the literature funnel, reads +1.2 cm; the deepest value is on the shore of Hengshui Lake (115.58E 37.63N), likely water-margin noise.
hengshui.publish_note: Not published (2026-11-14): status "unconfirmed", see unconfirmed_reason and location_check. The files that were published are kept in pipeline/out_v2/hengshui/unpublished/.
hengshui.unconfirmed_reason: Passed our automatic quality checks, but we don't see the sinking area described in published studies; our strongest signal is on the shore of Hengshui Lake, where water makes radar readings unreliable, so we don't report a number.
